name: Giant Boar
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Proficiency bonus +2. Passive Perception 8. No listed skill proficiencies, special senses or languages.
appearance: A massive wild boar with heavy shoulders, a ridge of dark bristles, a blunt snout and thick, upward-curving tusks.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (2018), Chapter 12, p. 131.
sections.Traits:
Charge. Move at least 20 ft. in a straight line toward a target, then hit it with Tusk on that turn to deal an extra 7 (2d6) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it makes a DC 13 Strength save or falls prone.
Relentless. When damage of 10 or less would reduce the boar to 0 HP, it drops to 1 HP instead. This trait recharges after a short or long rest.
sections.Actions: Tusk. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit against one target within 5 ft. On a hit, deal 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.At the table: Charge adds damage on a qualifying hit. The save only determines whether a creature falls prone.

name: Giant Centipede
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Proficiency bonus +2. Blindsight 30 ft., passive Perception 8. No listed skill proficiencies or languages.
appearance: A flattened, mahogany-brown centipede with orange jointed legs, long antennae and curved venom claws at the head.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (2018), Chapter 12, p. 131.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit against one creature within 5 ft. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 11 Constitution save and takes 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failure. If that poison damage reduces it to 0 HP, the creature is stable and poisoned for 1 hour. It is paralyzed for as long as it is poisoned by this effect, which persists if it regains HP.
sections.At the table: A successful Constitution save avoids the poison damage. The one-hour poisoned and paralyzed effect requires the poison damage to reduce the creature to 0 HP. The block gives no repeat save.

name: Giant Constrictor Snake
otherStatistics: Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +2. Blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 12. No listed languages.
appearance: A heavy-bodied, pythonlike snake with brown saddle markings, a blunt head and thick coils.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (2018), Chapter 12, p. 131.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit against one creature within 10 ft. On a hit, deal 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit against one creature within 5 ft. On a hit, deal 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and grapple it (escape DC 16). The creature is restrained for the duration of the grapple. The snake cannot constrict another target while holding it.
sections.At the table: Constrict applies its grapple on a hit. The target can spend an action on a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check to escape. The stat block gives no automatic damage on later turns.
